title: Canopy blocked documents
description: The catalogue's removal list, registry/blocked.json. One entry with a slug blocks that document; one without a slug blocks the whole repository. A maintainer adds an entry by pull request after deciding the report issue; the indexer honours it on its next run. Structural only: the rule that a slug needs its kind is checked by the validator, because JSON Schema cannot express it over sibling fields.

kind.description: The document kind. Ignored when no slug is named (the whole repository is blocked).

repo.description: The repository that holds the document, as owner/repo.

slug.description: The document slug. Without it, the whole repository is blocked.

reason.description: Why it left the catalogue, in the words the page shows.

issue.description: The report issue the removal was decided on; the author can appeal there.

blocked_at.description: The day the removal pull request landed.
